dialog.title: Enjoying Snow Media Center?
dialog.subtitle: Rate it out of 5 stars. Your review goes straight to the Snow Media team.
dialog.starsHint: Press left or right to choose the stars, then OK.
dialog.commentPlaceholder: What do you like? What could be better?
dialog.voiceHint: Or record a voice review (optional, up to 1 minute).
dialog.helpLine: Need help? Open a support ticket
dialog.thanksText: Your review helps us make Snow Media Center better.

settings.title: Rate Snow Media Center
settings.description: Give us stars and tell us what you think. On boxes with a microphone you can leave a voice review too.

errors.signIn: Sign in to send a review.
errors.voiceEmpty: Nothing was recorded. Try again or remove the voice review.
errors.voiceTooBig: The voice review is too long. Remove it and record a shorter one.
errors.voiceUpload: Your voice review couldn't be uploaded. Try again, or remove it and send the rest.
errors.sendFailed: Your review couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
